entries.question: Issue #359 (generated-section contract) is still open. How should this mission handle the generated sub-processor list page? (1) Split it into a final WP that waits on #359 being accepted, while the catalog, validation, agent API, change feed, tom_classification link and docs ship independently. (2) Build it now following #359's drafted contract (generated: {by, at, source_digest} stamp plus a --check drift gate), clearly marked provisional in ADR-0085 and on the page.

options: A: dedicated RSS + JSON changes from since/until (recommended)
entries.question: With the generated page deferred, what is the sub-processor change feed? (A) A dedicated RSS feed (subprocessors.xml), one item per addition (since) and per removal (until), plus the same entries as a changes list in api/subprocessors.json. Derived only from since/until, and carrying dates rather than a build-time 'current/upcoming' status so builds stay byte-stable. A future-dated since or until is how a site gives advance notice. (B) The same, but entries come from changelog fragments instead of since/until. (C) Only the JSON changes list in the agent API, with no RSS feed until the page WP.

entries.question: Record field set (⚖ counsel reviews it before it is called DPA-ready). Fields as in the issue: { id, name, address?, contact?, processing, location, responsibilities, since, until?, external_references?, tom_classification? }. external_references reuses the existing page shape (inline or {type: biblio, id}), and tom_classification reuses the page field shape from ADR-0080. Open point: how is  typed? (A) A non-empty list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. [DE, US]) with an optional free-text location_note. Machine-checkable, useful later for transfer analysis. (B) Free text. (C) Free text now, structured later. No transfer-mechanism field in any case; that is a follow-up issue.
